## Tantan 7.5.4 — Messages performance & placeholder fix

- Restored 5 FUNCTIONAL Messages cell binds wrongly voided as promo (ConversationMatchItemLayout.P, NewMatchItemLayout.o, ConversationFoldView.T, IntlVisitorConversationView.m0, ConversationItemUserStatesView.i) — fixes the permanent 'Matched %s' placeholder/shimmer; genuine promo binds stay suppressed
- GMS signature spoof: removed main-thread System.gc()+Thread.sleep(100) startup stall; cached SigningInfo field+template (single-field-set fast path on repeat queries); removed per-query log spam
- ConversationsList.O2 + deck home/c.y filters: scan-first, skip ArrayList allocation/copy when nothing to filter; O2 single List.get per item
- All changed targets DEX-verified in patched APK; patchApk + repackMppWithPatchList green
- All 16 patches apply to 7.5.4 (2754010)
